messages:
rhea: quick check on the console IA change: proposing 'Workloads' -> split into 'Models' and 'Runs' in the left nav. objective: make deep links intuitive for engineers who bookmark model pages.
marco: splitting makes sense. question: do we keep existing /workloads/ routes and add redirects or replace paths entirely?
lina: prefer backward-compatible redirects. users have lots of shared links. map old /workloads/:id to /projects/:pid/runs/:id or models depending on type. small redirect table will do.
preston: routing choice: use history API with server rewrites for shareability. avoid hash-only since social previews and oembed won't work.
rhea: agreed. also want canonical query param for panels: ?panel=metrics rather than hash. makes server-side canonicalization simpler.
a11y-bot: accessibility reminder: left nav must expose role="navigation", groups need aria-expanded and aria-controls. also add a visible "Skip to main" link for keyboard users.
marco: sidebar grouping: show group headers only when expanded; collapsed state becomes icon-only with tooltips. but keyboard users still need readable labels via aria-label and screen-reader-only text.
lina: breadcrumbs: show Project Name > Models > {Model Name}. do not include intermediate collection slugs in breadcrumb (keep it shallow). fallback to ID if name missing.
preston: microcopy: use plurals for list pages ("Models") and singular for detail pages ("Model"). keep casing consistent (Title Case) across nav and breadcrumbs.
rhea: dev route proposal snippet: 
```
/projects/:projectId/models
/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId
/projects/:projectId/runs/:runId
```
we'll add rewrite entries for /w/:wid -> /projects/:projectId/runs/:runId
marco: telemetry note: add event deep_link_open with source=nav|shared_link|pin for measuring shareability.
a11y-bot: also flag: focus management after route change. ensure main heading receives focus and aria-live for important toasts.
lina: agree. and for pinned shortcuts, they should be addressable under /shortcuts/:userId so people can share their pinned lists.
preston: ops note: server can serve minimal OG meta for known entity routes using a cache of titles/descriptions. ops will add rewrite rules in next deploy.
rhea: action items: 1) marco mock compact/collapsed state in Figma, 2) preston draft redirect map + server rewrite PR, 3) lina update breadcrumb rules doc, 4) a11y-bot to produce checklist and e2e keyboard tests.
marco: I'll post the Figma link by EOD. thanks everyone.
